job: Rework the Shine portfolio project and article into the V4 journey with before-and-after screenshots and an open-source architecture decision
primaryTask: Understand the decisions and failed versions that produced Shine V4, inspect the real before-and-after, and reach the live skill or source.

defects.problem: The article converts to the V3 skill but does not tell readers that the current product is V4 or why its architecture changed.
defects.evidence: The stamp, metadata, project description, and close all say v3.0.0 while the live skill is v4.0.2.
defects.expectedEffect: Align every conversion path with V4 and explain the shadcn/Base UI/React Aria decision before the close.

defects.problem: The journey stops at V3 and omits the final dogfood evidence, cross-media lanes, family-cap rule, and installed-symlink defect found by this portfolio test.
defects.evidence: The current article has no V3/V4 screenshots and its last product milestone is executable usability.
defects.expectedEffect: Add the real artifact pair and document the V4 director contract plus the failure the downstream test exposed.

defects.problem: The hero proof is a diagram of the old loop, so the article describes a visual product without showing the shipped visual result.
defects.evidence: The largest media object is an SVG process diagram; the actual V3 and V4 pages do not appear anywhere in the article.
defects.expectedEffect: Use the V4 page as the hero proof and place a wide, captioned before-and-after immediately after the initial problem.
